meta.name: Onboard employees and manage Slack access with Google Sheets and Gmail

name: HR Onboarding Automation — Slack + Google Sheets

parameters.content:
# 🏢 HR Onboarding Automation
## Workflow 1 — Employee Invite Sender

**What this workflow does:**
When HR submits a new employee form, this workflow:
1. Validates the submitted data
2. Saves employee record to Google Sheets
3. Maps department → Slack channels
4. Sends a welcome email with Slack invite link
5. Notifies the manager on Slack
6. Updates employee status in the sheet

**Trigger:** POST webhook from HR dashboard/form
**Required fields:** full_name, email, department, role, manager_email, start_date

**Tech Stack:**
- n8n (automation engine)
- Google Sheets (employee database)
- Gmail (welcome email)
- Slack (manager notification)

## 📥 Step 1 — Webhook Trigger

This node listens for POST requests from the HR form/dashboard.

**Endpoint:**
`POST /webhook/onboard-employee`

**Expected JSON Body:**
```json
{
  "full_name": "Ali Raza",
  "email": "ali@company.com",
  "department": "Engineering",
  "role": "Backend Developer",
  "manager_email": "mgr@company.com",
  "start_date": "2026-07-15"
}
```

⚠️ Use `/webhook-test/` URL while testing.
Use `/webhook/` URL in production (workflow must be Active).

## ✅ Step 2 — Validation

Checks that these 3 fields are not empty:
- `full_name`
- `email`
- `department`

**TRUE branch →** Continue onboarding
**FALSE branch →** Return 400 error response

Note: Fields come from `$json.body.*` because n8n wraps webhook payloads in a `body` object.

## 💾 Step 3 — Save to Google Sheets

Appends a new row to the **Sheet1** tab.

**Columns written:**
full_name, email, department, role, manager_email, start_date

**Auto-filled later:**
- `status` → updated by this workflow + WF2
- `slack_invited_at` → timestamp when invite sent
- `slack_user_id` → filled when employee joins Slack

📌 Sheet ID: `1kGaxbKg-6SZTWqWFXL2GZz0WvUaC8PTsOpZ8tySKpLo`

## 🗂️ Step 4 — Department → Channel Mapping

Maps each department to relevant Slack channels.

**Current Mapping:**
- Engineering → all-testn8n, new-channel
- Sales → all-testn8n, social
- Marketing → all-testn8n, social
- HR → all-testn8n, new-channel
- Design → all-testn8n, social

Also attaches the static **Slack Workspace Invite Link**.

⚠️ Update `SLACK_INVITE_LINK` with a fresh link from:
Slack → Workspace name → Invite people → Get invite link

## 📧 Step 5 — Welcome Email

Sends a welcome email to the new employee.

**Contains:**
- Personalized greeting with name, role, department
- Start date
- Slack workspace invite link (static link)
- Instructions to click and join

**Gmail credential required.**

⚠️ Non-Enterprise Slack limitation:
We cannot auto-create Slack accounts via API.
Employee must click the invite link themselves.
Workflow 2 handles the rest once they join.

## 🔔 Step 6 — Notify Manager

Sends a Slack DM to the employee's manager.

**Message includes:**
- Employee name, department, role
- Start date
- Channels they'll be added to
- Confirmation that invite email was sent

**Slack OAuth2 credential required.**

Currently set to user ID `U0BDTGNCMJQ` for testing.
In production: resolve manager's Slack user ID dynamically from their email.

## 📝 Step 7 — Update Sheet Status

Updates the employee row in Google Sheets:
- `status` → "Invite Sent"
- `slack_invited_at` → current timestamp

Matches row by `email` column (must be unique).

HR can see in real-time:
- **Invite Sent** = email sent, waiting to join
- **Joined** = added to channels ✓ (set by WF2)

## ⚙️ Setup Checklist

**Before going live, make sure:**

✅ Google Sheets has columns:
full_name, email, department, role, manager_email, start_date, status, slack_invited_at, slack_user_id

✅ Slack App has scopes:
users:read, users:read.email, channels:read, channels:manage, chat:write

✅ Slack App → Event Subscriptions → team_join subscribed

✅ Workflow 2 is **Active** (toggle ON in n8n)

✅ Bot invited to all target channels (`/invite @DemoApp`)

✅ Static Slack invite link updated in 'Map Department + Attach Invite Link' node

✅ Department names match exactly:
Engineering, Sales, Marketing, HR, Design

nodes.name: Send Welcome Email with Slack Invite Link

parameters.message:
=

Welcome aboard, {{ $json.full_name }}!

We're thrilled to have you join us as {{ $json.role }} in the {{ $json.department }} team, starting {{ $json.start_date }}.

Step 1: Click the link below to join our Slack workspace:

{{ $json.slack_invite_link }}

Once you join, you'll automatically be added to your team's channels and our bot will say hi!

See you soon!

parameters.content:
# 🔗 Workflow 2 — Slack Team Join Listener

**What this workflow does:**
Listens for Slack's `team_join` event (fired when anyone joins the workspace). When triggered:
1. Verifies it's a real event (not URL verification challenge)
2. Extracts new user's email + Slack user ID
3. Looks up their record in Google Sheets
4. Maps department to channels
5. Adds user to each channel one by one
6. Sends a welcome DM on Slack
7. Updates sheet status to "Joined"

**Setup Required:**
- Slack App → Event Subscriptions → Enable
- Request URL: `https://umarimran99999.app.n8n.cloud/webhook/slack-team-join`
- Subscribe to bot event: `team_join`
- This workflow must be **Active** (toggle ON)

**Required Slack Scopes:**
`users:read`, `users:read.email`, `channels:read`, `channels:manage`, `chat:write`

## 🤝 URL Verification Challenge

When you first save the Request URL in Slack's Event Subscriptions, Slack sends a one-time verification request:
```json
{ "type": "url_verification", "challenge": "abc123" }
```

This IF node checks for that.

**TRUE →** Echo back the challenge (Slack marks URL as Verified ✓)
**FALSE →** It's a real event, continue processing

⚠️ This workflow must be **Active** and use the production `/webhook/` URL for Slack verification to work.

## ⚡ Acknowledge First, Process Later

Slack requires a response within **3 seconds** or it retries the event (causing duplicate processing).

So we:
1. Immediately respond `{ ok: true }` (this node)
2. Then continue with the actual processing below

This is standard Slack Events API best practice.

## 👤 Extract User Info

Extracts from the `team_join` Slack event payload:
- `slack_user_id` → user.id (e.g. U0XXXXXXX)
- `email` → user.profile.email
- `real_name` → user's display name

These are used to look up the employee in Google Sheets and to send them a welcome DM.

## 🔍 Lookup in Google Sheets

Searches Sheet1 for a row where `email` matches the email from Slack's event.

This connects the Slack join event back to the original onboarding record created by Workflow 1.

Returns: full_name, department, role, manager_email, start_date.

⚠️ If no match found (employee joined via a different email than HR entered), the workflow will fail here. HR should ensure emails match.

## 🔄 Split Channels + Get IDs

**Split Out Channels:**
Breaks the `target_channels` array into individual items so each channel is processed separately (Slack API accepts one channel per invite call).

**Get Channel ID by Name:**
Calls `conversations.list` to fetch all workspace channels with their IDs.

**Match Channel Name to ID:**
Finds the channel whose `name` matches our target, extracts its ID.

⚠️ Channel names must exactly match Slack channel names (no `#` prefix, lowercase).

## ➕ Add to Channel + Welcome DM

**Add User to Channel:**
Calls Slack's `conversations.invite` with the resolved channel ID and the new user's Slack ID.

`continueOnFail: true` — if one channel fails (bot not in channel, wrong ID), it continues to the next instead of stopping.

**Send Welcome DM:**
Sends a personalized direct message to the new employee on Slack with their role and department.

⚠️ Bot must be manually invited to each target channel first:
`/invite @YourBotName` in each channel

## ✅ Final Status Update

Updates the employee's row in Google Sheets:
- `status` → "Joined"
- `slack_invited_at` → current timestamp

Matches by `email` column.

HR can now see in the sheet:
- **Invite Sent** = email sent, waiting for employee to join
- **Joined** = employee has joined Slack and been added to channels ✓

parameters.text:
=:wave: Welcome to the team, *{{ $('Find Employee Row by Email').item.json.full_name }}*! :tada:

You've been added to your team's channels. Glad to have you here as *{{ $('Find Employee Row by Email').item.json.role }}* in *{{ $('Find Employee Row by Email').item.json.department }}*!

Feel free to say hi in your channels — the team is excited to meet you! :rocket:
